title: When Can Unlabeled Data Pools Replace Membership Queries?
abstract: arXiv:2610.41001v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Membership queries let a learner label arbitrary points and give near-optimal $\tilde O(n\log(1/\eps))$ label complexity for halfspaces under every marginal. A pool learner may label only sampled points. We ask when unlabeled data can replace membership queries. For homogeneous halfspaces the answer depends only on the angular law of $X/\|X\|$. If this law assigns zero mass to every hyperplane through the origin and positive mass to every nonempty open set of directions together with its reflection, a pool learner uses $O(n\log^3n\log(n/(\eps\delta)))$ labels, uniformly over all such marginals and targets, without density, moment, concavity or isotropy assumptions. The same label bound holds for non-homogeneous halfspaces under every marginal with full support and no mass on affine hyperplanes, including Gaussians. Dropping either angular assumption admits $\Omega(1/\eps)$ pool versus $O(\log(1/\eps))$ membership-query separations, even

translated_title: 何时可以用未标记数据池取代成员查询？
translated_abstract: 成员查询允许学习者为任意点标注标签，并使得半空间学习在任意边缘分布下达到接近最优的 $\tilde O(n\log(1/\eps))$ 标签复杂度；而池学习者只能对已采样到的点进行标注。本文研究何时未标记数据可以取代成员查询。对于齐次半空间，答案仅取决于 $X/\|X\|$ 的角向分布：若该分布对每个过原点的超平面赋予零质量，并对每个非空开的方向集合及其反射赋予正质量，则池学习者在所有此类边缘分布和目标上一致地只需 $O(n\log^3n\log(n/(\eps\delta)))$ 个标签，且无需密度、矩、凹性或各向同性等假设。同样的标签界对非齐次半空间在所有满支撑且在仿射超平面上无质量的边缘分布（包括高斯分布）下也成立。若去掉任一角向假设，则会出现池学习者需 $\Omega(1/\eps)$ 个标签而成员查询仅需 $O(\log(1/\eps))$ 个标签的分离现象，甚至……
tldr: 本文证明了只要数据的方向分布满足温和的角向正则性条件（对过原点的超平面零质量、对非空开方向集及其反射正质量），未标记数据池即可在无需密度、矩、凹性或各向同性假设的情况下，以接近最优的标签复杂度取代成员查询来学习半空间，并在条件不满足时给出了标签复杂度的显著分离。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that under mild angular regularity conditions on the direction distribution of the data, unlabeled data pools can replace membership queries for learning halfspaces with near-optimal label complexity—without density, moment, concavity, or isotropy assumptions—and exhibits sharp separations when these conditions fail.
